name: Drift

provenance.note: style-1 creep (+2.5 %/s after the last key) / Dark Vox drift (+1.5 %/s)

summary: Under every held shot so nothing is ever dead still (Moovi law: every scene moves); talking heads, held titles, product stills.

data.about: A barely visible, constant push with a slow float: the frame is alive without anything happening.
data.avoid: When a deliberate lock-off is the joke or the point.
